_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
D uqeddac {player_id} i d-turared di urar n Liar's Dice akked {num_players} n uqeddacn.
Tisḍaf:
- Di tura-inek, tzemreḍ ad teddeḍ:
  1) Rnu tiddas tamaynut s kantita meqqren neɣ azal meqqren (neɣ snat) n tiddas tura; i.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Sseɣret tiddas tazelmaḍt s useɣret '[Call]'.

Ma sseɣreḍ:
  - Ma azal n tififen i d-yeglan di meṛṛa n tififen ila meẓẓiy n tiddas, uqeddac aneggaru i d-yefɣen itexser die.
  - Ma ulac, uqeddac i d-yefɣen itexser die.
Uqeddac i d-iwḍen 0 n tififen ittwaxser. Uqeddac aneggaru i d-iḍelli rebbiḥ.

board.new_round:
Asagen aɣelnaw - Imeɣriyen ɣakken: {dice_summary}
Imeɣriyen inu ilulen d: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Uqeddac {current_player_id} isseɣret! Azal n tififen {face_value} d {count}, i d-ila meẓẓiy n {quantity}.
Uqeddac {loser_id} (aneggaru i d-yefɣen) itexser die.
call.caller_loses:
Uqeddac {current_player_id} isseɣret! Azal n tififen {face_value} d {count}, i d-ila >= {quantity}.
Uqeddac {loser_id} (isseɣret) itexser die.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: ⵜⵉⵖⵔⴰ ⵙ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵍⵍⵉ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵔⴰⵔⵓⵜ.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Aseqqed ur yeṭṭef ara d akken daɣen d '[Bid: X, Y]' neɣ '[Call]'. Aseqqed anṣli: {action}
